kind: bounded exploratory addendum to the stage-2 panel
premise: Stage 2 measured whether excluded quiet drops create geometrically profitable blind threats. Four did, but all four were refuted at depth 1 and none was chosen at a 200k-node depth-3 re-search. The remaining consumer question is direct: would the search value any excluded drop above its own served root choice?
question: Across the 238 excluded quiet drops in the stage-2 panel, how many have a child-search mover value strictly above the parent's served depth-2 score (and depth-3 score), and how many are static-material improvements over the parent?

inputs.state_reconstruction: same generated rule and sample_start2 offset as the stored position record
inputs.parent_scores: stored d2_score and d3_score from the stage-2 run (20k nodes, qdepth 4/hard 8, TT off, ordering on)
inputs.child_search: run_root_search from the excluded-drop child with max_depth=2, max_nodes=20000, quiescence_max_depth=4, quiescence_hard_max_depth=8, use_tt=False, use_ordering=True
inputs.child_confirm: for candidates above the parent d3 score, re-run the child at max_depth=3, max_nodes=200000 and record the reason
inputs.static_check: mover static after drop = -evaluator.evaluate(child) compared with evaluator.evaluate(parent); no search

decision_rule_written_before_run.depth_matched_count: Count excluded drops with child depth-2 mover value strictly greater than the stored parent d3 score. Both searches cover three plies from the parent, so this is the depth-matched improvement test. Also count exact ties.
decision_rule_written_before_run.shallower_reference_count: Count excluded drops with child depth-2 mover value strictly greater than the stored parent d2 score. This is not depth-matched (drop plus two plies versus two plies) and is reported only as a reference.
decision_rule_written_before_run.static_count: Count excluded drops whose static mover value after the drop exceeds the parent static score.
decision_rule_written_before_run.interpretation: Zero in all three counts supports 'no excluded drop was valued above the served root choice in this panel' as a descriptive statement, not a proof of harmlessness. Any candidate above the parent d3 score is listed with its depth-3/200k confirmation; a score above the parent is sensitivity, not proof of strength, and may reflect search noise, ties or truncation.
decision_rule_written_before_run.mate_bound: Parents whose stored d2 or d3 score is at or beyond MATE_THRESHOLD are counted separately and excluded from improvement comparisons.

resource_bound.on_cap: stop, write partial results with interrupted=true and the completed seed list; do not pool partial counts as a complete panel
resource_bound.reason: single bounded run well below 120 minutes; no games, training, product change or frozen-panel rerun

consumer: States whether the conservative drop exclusion is empirically harmless in the owned 4x4 generated panel, or whether a larger study is warranted.
explicit_nonclaims: exploratory addendum, not a pre-registered confirmation of the stage-2 endpoint
child search values are not utility or playing strength
one position per generated rule; not a population statement
no product code, default, cap or frozen-panel change
done_condition: counts, candidate list, cap/interruption status and source hashes recorded; report states the descriptive answer and limits.
